call_purpose: Your custom domain shop.testfunnel.example had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, even though your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you opened the domain in an incognito window and checked its status in your dashboard, which showed "Not connected"; the same error in incognito ruled out a browser cache issue.
You deleted the old A record for shop and added a CNAME record for shop, and after that the dashboard showed the domain as connected and shop.testfunnel.example loaded.
You then deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, and you confirmed that both shop.testfunnel.example and the www version now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that an old A record for shop, pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection, and that it needed to be replaced with a CNAME record using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
We also explained that the www version showed an error because a second record for www pointed somewhere else, and that it needed a CNAME with the same target value.
We mentioned that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that the secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.

technical_details.text: The CNAME records for shop and for www use the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.
